steps.en: Clone the skill into your Claude Code skills folder
steps.zh: 把 skill 克隆进 Claude Code 技能目录

steps.en: On first use, builds an isolated Python environment and installs Chrome plus the automation stack for you
steps.zh: 首次使用时自建隔离 Python 环境，装好 Chrome 和自动化栈

steps.en: Do a one-time Google login in the Chrome window it opens
steps.zh: 在它弹出的 Chrome 窗口里做一次 Google 登录

steps.en: Share each notebook by link and register it in the local library
steps.zh: 把笔记本按链接共享，并登记进本地 library
steps.code: Add this NotebookLM to my library: [your-link]

steps.en: Opens a fresh real Chrome per question, asks Gemini, and returns the citation-backed answer to the CLI
steps.zh: 开新真实 Chrome 问 Gemini，带回带引用的答案

value.en: source-grounded, citation-backed answers from your own uploaded docs land in the terminal — no copy-paste dance between the browser and your editor
value.zh: 自己上传文档里有来源依据、带引用的答案直接落回终端——不再在浏览器和编辑器之间复制粘贴

sources: README.md master (raw.githubusercontent.com/PleasePrompto/notebooklm-skill/master/README.md, retrieved 2026-09-27): Installation 'cd ~/.claude/skills' + 'git clone https://github.com/PleasePrompto/notebooklm-skill notebooklm'; Quick Start '"Set up NotebookLM authentication"', '"Add this NotebookLM to my library: [your-link]"'; first-use auto-setup of .venv + Google Chrome; Architecture: scripts ask_question.py / notebook_manager.py / auth_manager.py; Session Model: fresh browser per question
